"""Record actual final local verification without changing authored pages."""

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-final-local-checks.json"
COMMANDS = [
    [sys.executable, "scripts/build_course.py", "--check"],
    [sys.executable, "scripts/check_course_reviews.py"],
    [sys.executable, "scripts/check_technical_reviews.py"],
    [sys.executable, "docs/review-tools/check_review_round.py", "--stage", "all"],
    [sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.reading_time", "validate", "--executed"],
    [sys.executable, "scripts/check_site.py", "--site", "outputs/integration-preview"],
    [sys.executable, "-m", "ruff", "check", "."],
    [sys.executable, "-m", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."],
    ["git", "diff", "--check"],
    [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q"],
]


def execute(command):
    started = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = {
        "command": command,
        "started_at": started,
        "finished_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "exit_code": run.returncode,
        "stdout": run.stdout,
        "stderr": run.stderr,
    }
    print(json.dumps({"command": command, "exit_code": run.returncode, "stdout": run.stdout[-1000:]}), flush=True)
    return record


with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    records = list(pool.map(execute, COMMANDS))
bindings = {}
for folder in ("course", "notebooks", "tiny_perceptron", "scripts", ".github/workflows"):
    for path in sorted((ROOT / folder).rglob("*")):
        if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts and path.suffix != ".pyc":
            bindings[path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name in ("docs/validation.md", "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-current-notebooks.json"):
    bindings[name] = hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
result = {
    "status": "passed" if all(row["exit_code"] == 0 for row in records) else "failed",
    "scope": "Actual local commands on the current working tree, bound to its input hashes. The existing executed notebook copies are checked by the site exporter and their separate current-notebook receipt; this command does not rerun notebook kernels or GPU training. Final CI and Pages are separately checked at the pushed revision.",
    "checked_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "input_sha256": bindings,
    "commands": records,
    "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "verification_program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
if result["status"] != "passed":
    raise SystemExit(1)
